moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio loading-dots, written here): Three 10 px accent dots, 12 px gap. Each dot: y 0 → −10 px → 0 and opacity 0.35 → 1 → 0.35 over a 900 ms loop, sine.inOut; dot k starts k × 90 ms later (recipe: −9 px, 110 ms apart). Label PLEASE WAIT below. Params: dots (3 × 10 px, cách 12 px) · bob (10 px) · each (0.09 s) · period (0.9 s) · ease (sine.inOut).
